text:
Avery: FYI noticed a sharp delta in per-token cost on the econ dashboard for route=chat/assist starting ~16:12 UTC, ~+22% vs baseline.
Avery: Cache_savings metric dropped and fallback_rate to model=llama-xl doubled.
Ramesh: Any deploys or config changes around that time?
AlertBot: deploy: api-router v2.9.0 -> v2.9.1 at 16:09 UTC by ci/deploy-bot
Tess: Router tweak could change affinity -> smaller batches -> higher effective token cost. Did the batcher.drain_time move?
Avery: I sampled logs, saw many batcher.drain_timeout entries + increased model_fallback events for tenant=knowledge-base.
Avery: Example log: ```WARN batcher: tenant=knowledge-base drain_timeout=180ms route=chat/assist fallback=llama-xl```
Priya: Ugh. We still don't expose per-route batcher latency distribution in the econ dashboard, only aggregated. That's making root cause slower.
Nate: Short-term mitigation: we can set runtime override to `router.affinity_mode=sticky` for tenant=knowledge-base; that'll preserve previous batching behavior.
Ramesh: Can we do a targeted rollout (traffic-split) rather than blanket flag? We should avoid tenant-specific hacks unless necessary.
Priya: Agree on carefulness, but if the cost is spiking and SLA risk exists, a tenant-scoped override buys breathing room.
Tess: Also let's add a temporary console card: per-route (route=chat/assist) metrics for cache_hit_rate, batcher.drain_time P50/P95, and fallback_rate by model_variant.
Avery: +1. And an alert: if cache_hit_rate drops >10% for 5m and fallback_rate >3x trigger paging.
Nate: I'll flip the runtime flag to sticky for that tenant for 15m and monitor.
AlertBot: runtime-change: router.affinity_mode=sticky applied to tenant=knowledge-base at 16:28 UTC by Nate
Avery: After override cache_savings improved within 3 minutes, fallback_rate normalized. Cost delta trending back down.
Ramesh: Follow-ups: 1) Add per-route batcher metrics to telemetry pipeline (ingest + retention). 2) Add a lightweight sampled trace (1%) capturing route headers + model selection decisions for 24h. 3) Add a post-rollback note in the release doc for v2.9.x.
Tess: I'll own the dashboard hotfix tile (batcher.drain_time & fallback_rate).
Priya: I'll own the sampled trace + S3 retention.
Nate: I'll write the staging test to simulate router affinity changes and measure token-unit cost.
Avery: Also, can we add a console UX affordance to preview estimated cost impact of toggling affinity mode per-tenant? (small simulator)
Ramesh: Love that — would make ops decisions faster. Add to roadmap as a small feature.
Avery: Thanks team. I'll capture a short incident note for the econ channel and tag billing/product. :thumbsup:
